hook.first_3_seconds: Extreme close-up on trader's eyes darting left and right between monitors, conveying stress and information overload.
hook.visual: Extreme close-up of trader's eyes, reflection showing chaotic red/green signals on multiple monitors.

scenes.visual: Extreme close-up of trader's eyes darting rapidly between monitors, showing chaotic red/green signals and text alerts. Screen reflections and visual noise multiply around the trader.
scenes.camera: Static extreme close-up on eyes with slight handheld jitter to convey tension.
scenes.lighting: Desk lamp light creates sharp reflections on glasses, mixed with the flickering light from monitors.
scenes.environment: Trader's desk at night, multiple monitors in background, screen glow on face.
scenes.subject: Trader's eyes and upper face.
scenes.action: Eyes moving quickly between monitors, pupils dilating with stress. Information overload visualized as multiplying signals.
scenes.voiceover: The problem is not a lack of information; it is the noise around it.
sound_effects: Rapid, dissonant electronic glitches increasing in intensity
scenes.transition: Pull back to reveal the full desk setup.
scenes.compliance_notes: Visual metaphor for information overload only. No performance claims.

scenes.visual: Pull back reveals split-screen: left shows chaotic signal flood (flashing red/green alerts, conflicting data streams), right shows CrowdWisdom's organized research panel with clean consensus indicators. Hand moves to toggle the CrowdWisdom view.
scenes.camera: Slow pull back from close-up to wide desk shot, then subtle push-in on the active CrowdWisdom panel.
scenes.lighting: Left side: harsh saturated monitor glow. Right side: cooler, more organized panel lighting.
scenes.environment: Full desk setup at night, multiple monitors, ergonomic chair.
scenes.subject: Trader's hand, split-screen monitors.
scenes.action: Hand moves from keyboard to toggle switch, activating the CrowdWisdom filtered view. Left-side noise gradually recedes visually.
scenes.voiceover: CrowdWisdom filters and scores market viewpoints rather than treating every opinion equally.
sound_effects: Left-side noise begins to filter out
scenes.music_direction: Motif begins to cohere, chaotic layers resolve into structured rhythm.
scenes.transition: Cut to close-up on the CrowdWisdom research panel.
scenes.compliance_notes: Visual explanation of filtering concept. No guaranteed outcomes depicted.

scenes.visual: Close-up on CrowdWisdom research panel: conviction, consensus, and recency scoring meters animate in. Weaker viewpoints fade while stronger ones organize into structured layers. Signal lines converge toward a central indicator.
scenes.camera: Static close-up on the panel, slow tilt to follow converging signal lines.
scenes.lighting: Cool digital panel illumination, subtle glow from active meters.
scenes.environment: Right monitor of the split-screen, left side out of focus but still visible.
scenes.subject: CrowdWisdom research panel UI, scoring meters.
scenes.action: Bars and meters animate into place, signal lines flow and converge, forming a coherent direction.
scenes.voiceover: Viewpoints are scored and synthesized using factors such as conviction, consensus, and recent performance.
scenes.music_direction: Pulse becomes rhythmic and unified, building toward resolution.
scenes.transition: Cut to medium shot of the trader reviewing the structured setup.
scenes.compliance_notes: Pure visual metaphor for scoring methodology. No specific confidence percentages or predictions.

scenes.visual: Medium shot: trader reviewing the structured research card showing direction, entry, stop, and targets. The card forms progressively with each element appearing. Left-side noise remains visible but out of focus and ignored.
scenes.camera: Slow push-in on the research card with shallow depth of field blurring the noisy left screen.
scenes.lighting: Research card emits a soft glow, left screen provides contrasting but de-emphasized light.
scenes.environment: Desk, focus on the right monitor and the trader's focused expression.
scenes.subject: Trader's hands/fingers, research card UI (direction, entry, stop, targets).
scenes.action: Research card elements animate in: direction arrow, entry price, stop level, target levels. Trader's posture shifts from tension to focus.
scenes.voiceover: Many viewpoints converge into a structured consensus view. Each idea is structured around direction, entry, stop, and targets.
scenes.music_direction: Single melodic line emerges, calm and confident.
scenes.transition: Cut to the trader leaning back as the platform resolves.
scenes.compliance_notes: Structured research framework only. No execution, no guarantees, no broker claims.

scenes.visual: CrowdWisdom logo appears center screen with tagline 'Collective Intelligence for Traders' and a small compliance note. The trader is visible in the background, relaxed and in control, reinforcing that execution remains with the user.
scenes.camera: Static wide shot, logo fades in from center, tagline slides up from below.
scenes.lighting: Logo backlit with soft glow, ambient background light.
scenes.environment: Dark background to focus on branding, faint trader silhouette visible.
scenes.subject: CrowdWisdom logo, tagline, compliance note.
scenes.action: Logo and text appear and hold. Trader silhouette nods in quiet confidence.
scenes.voiceover: CrowdWisdom Trading is a research platform; you remain in control of execution.
scenes.music_direction: Melody holds briefly then fades to silence.
on_screen_text: CrowdWisdom Trading is a research platform; you remain in control of execution.
scenes.compliance_notes: Explicit research platform positioning. No execution claims. No performance guarantees. Clear responsible close.

cta.visual: The tagline 'Collective Intelligence for Traders' holds with a subtle text CTA 'Learn more at crowdwisdomtrading.com' at the bottom.
